notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

based on a feedback received we updated Womanizer.

Here the list of new features (some of them were done earlier, but weren't officially announced):

1.Korean language is implemented.
2.Easy-mode for mini games added in Settings.
3.Quantity of evidence needed for finding the murderer is optimized
4.Some bugs, reported by community, fixed.

The main goal was to make the game a bit less complicated.

Regards,
kamti

notes.title: Small bugfix
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Womanzier has been updated.

Changes:

- fixed small visual inconsistencies reported, like the portrait of the girls in Victor's room, while other girls visiting.
- implemented test version of Rollback function during using the in-game phone. I assume it needs more testing, so plaese report if you meet the problems while using.  Please check Setting for activation.
- fixed disappearing of text window after opening save/load screen
- fixed disappearing of text window and phone icon after using "Tab" key to reach save/load screens

Thank you for information you provide and your patience. 

Regards,
KamtiGames

notes.title: Small bugfix
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Womanzier has been updated.

Changes:

- added few missing arts: accompanying girls after gymanstick hall, scene with Sveta at home, etc.
- changed some static arts to animated ones in scene with Tanya
- removed some bugs, which were reported (in-game mechanics + gallery)
- improved German localization, based on players' feedback


Thank you for information you provide and your patience. 
We try to react fast. Minor issues are improved, more complicated things will be improved in the next days/weeks depending on a complexity.

Regards,
KamtiGames

notes.title: Womanizer Release Date & Global Steam Key Giveaway!
notes.notes:
We're super excited to announce that Womanizer is available on Steam.
All players who own the game can participate in contest.

Thank you to our incredible volunteers who have helped edit and polish the multiple translations of the game in preparation for the Steam release.

To celebrate this milestone, we're hosting a Global Steam Key Giveaway!

糖醋猪猪 has been a massive help with the Chinese - Simplified translation and has generously offered 15 Steam keys (any KamtiGames present or future game) for this giveaway as a token of thanks to all of the amazing Womanizer fans from around the world.

Here's how to enter:
Comment on this post in any language any time before Monday, May 6 at 08:00 CEST.

We'll contact the lucky winners through Steam on Monday, May 6.

Thanks for your support!
KamtiGames
